ayahOccurrences.text: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَرَزَقَنِى مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ ۚ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ ۚ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِىٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ

ayahOccurrences.text: قَالَ لَا يَأْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِۦٓ إِلَّا نَبَّأْتُكُمَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِى رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنِّى تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ

ر/ز/ق   r–z–q provision, livelihood, earnings, means of living, subsistence, income, bounty, (of God) to provide with means of living, to seek to earn a living, (of God) to bestow with bounties or to favour with bounties, to grant as means of sustenance.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 123 times in the Qur’an:
رَزَقَ razaqa 56 times; رُزِقَ ruziqa 5 times; رِزْقٌ rizq 55 times; رَازِقُون rāziqūn 6 times and رَزَّاقٌ razzāq 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
رَزَقَ razaqa u I [v. trans., pass. v. رُزِقَ ruziqa]

1 (of God) to sustain

(30:40) اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ God it is who creates you then sustains you, then causes you to die, then gives you life again

2 (of God) to provide something for someone

(2:172) كُلُوا مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ eat of the good things We have provided for you

3 to make provisions for, to give maintenance to

(4:5) وَلاَ تُؤْتُوا السُّفَهَاءَ أَمْوَالَكُمُ الَّتِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِيَامًا وَارْزُقُوهُمْ فِيهَا وَاكْسُوهُمْ and do not give to the feeble‐minded the property which God has assigned [as if it were your own] to manage; make provision for them from it and clothe them

4 to give something as charity

(4:8) وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُو الْقُرْبَى وَالْيَتَامَى وَالْمَسَاكِينُ فَارْزُقُوهُمْ مِنْهُ and if some non‐inheriting relatives, orphans and the poor attend the distribution of the inheritance, give them something of it [as charity]

5 to reward

(22:58) وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا فِى سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوا أَوْ مَاتُوا لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ اللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا those who migrated in the cause of God then were killed or died, God will provide for them a goodly reward II [doubly trans.] to make provisions for, to give maintenance to

(16:75) وَمَنْ رَزَقْنَاهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا and someone We have endowed with good provision from Us, so he spends from it secretly and openly.

entries.label: الرَّزَّاقُ
entries.definitionHtml:
الرَّزَّاقُ ʾal‐razzāq [intens. act. part., appears in Qur’an only in definite form], [attribute of God] the Supreme Provider

(51:58) إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ God is the Supreme Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever‐Mighty.

entries.label: رَازِقُون
entries.definitionHtml:
رَازِقُون rāziqūn [pl. of act. part. رَازِقٌ rāziq] (particularly of God) bounty‐giver, sustainer, provider

(15:20) وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنْ لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ We have provided sustenance in it [the earth] for you and for those [creatures] for whom you are not providers.

entries.label: رِزْقٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
رِزْقٌ rizq [n.; v. n.]

1 fortunes, bounty from God, livelihood; providing for

(51:22) وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ in heavens is [the deciding of] your fortunes [also interpreted as: in the sky is [the source of] your sustenance [the clouds]] and all that you are promised

2 provision, sustenance

(10:59) أَرَأَيْتُمْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَجَعَلْتُمْ مِنْهُ حَرَامًا وَحَلاَلا have you considered what provision God has sent down for you, of which you have made some unlawful and some lawful?

3 maintenance, to maintain

(2:233) وَعَلَى الْمَوْلُودِ لَهُ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ and the maintaing and clothing of them is incumbent upon the father [lit. the one for whom the child has been begotten].
